name: MoCo-NeRF
definition: A framework for free-viewpoint rendering of monocular human videos that models non-rigid motions as radiance residual fields rather than spatial offsets, using rigid skeletal transformations as a prior.
summary: MoCo-NeRF is a framework for free-viewpoint rendering of monocular human videos that models non-rigid motions as radiance residuals rather than spatial offsets to avoid high computational complexity.
